description: This file defines the 'BestSeller' controller class for an OpenCart module, responsible for retrieving and displaying best-selling products in the storefront. It loads language resources, models, and configuration settings, fetches bestseller data, processes images and prices, and renders the output view with a list of products.

classes.name: BestSeller
classes.description: Controller class handling the display of best-selling products in OpenCart. Extends the core Controller class, loads necessary models and language, processes product data, and renders the bestsellers module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method invoked to generate the bestsellers module output. Loads languages, models, retrieves bestseller data, processes product images, prices and descriptions, and returns the rendered view or an empty string if no products are found.
